variant_decisions.evidence: ASV renders the reading verbally as 'Great deliverance giveth he,' distinguishing the qere/base מַגְדִּיל ('giveth/maketh great') from the ketiv noun מגדל ('tower'). The note 'Hebrew salvations' glosses the plural object and does not indicate a textual variant.
